store.description: Capture your screen, keep just the region you need, mark it up with a pen, highlighter, box or arrow, then save it to Pictures or copy it to the clipboard.
features: Screen, window or tab capture through the browser's own picker
Drag a box to keep exactly the region you want
Pen, highlighter, rectangle and arrow marks
Save as PNG in Pictures, or copy the image to the clipboard
Desktop browsers only — the app explains itself on iOS
